newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Grenfell says Gawler tests show gold.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Grenfell says Gawler tests show gold.

text.p: Grenfell Resources NL said on Tuesday that it had encountered an intercept of four metres, grading 20.1 grams of gold a tonne from 20 metres at a new eastern zone within it Perseverance property in the promising Gawler Craton region of South Australia.
Another zone to the west of the Perseverance shear had been encountered, with an intercept of 12 metres, grading 0.8 grams a tonne from 36 metres, the company said.

At the Mulgathing prospect, 10 km southwest of Perseverance, shallow drilling had encountered widespread low-order gold values, the highest being five metres, grading 0.5 grams a tonne, Grenfell said.
It said it considerd the results significant, given the shallow depths and the presence of a leached zone.
At the Boomerang prospect, eight km south-southwest of Perseverance, results had been received from 37 drill holes, with low-order mineralisation recorded, Grenfell said.
The best intercept to date had been from the BG30 sector, which returned four metres, grading 1.3 grams a tonne from 44 metres, the company said.

Exploration work was expected to be increased at each of the three propsects in 1997, the company said. Also, two additional propsects within four km of Perseverance, called Curdnatta and Excelsior, will be tested, Grenfell said.
These prospects occur on the same contact zone and are associated with shears apparently similar to the Perseverance shear, it said.
